columns.name: ad_group_id
columns.comment: The ID of the ad group.

columns.name: campaign_id
columns.comment: The ID of the campaign.

columns.name: customer_id
columns.comment: The ID of the customer.

columns.name: geographic_view_country_criterion_id
columns.comment: Criterion Id for the country.

columns.name: ad_group_name
columns.comment: The name of the ad group. This field is required and should not be empty when creating new ad groups. It must contain fewer than 255 UTF-8 full-width characters. It must not contain any null (code point 0x0), NL line feed (code point 0xA) or carriage return (code point 0xD) characters.

columns.name: ad_group_status
columns.comment: The status of the ad group.

columns.name: campaign_status
columns.comment: The status of the campaign. When a new campaign is added, the status defaults to ENABLED.

columns.name: geographic_view_location_type
columns.comment: Type of the geo targeting of the campaign.

columns.name: metrics_all_conversions
columns.comment: The total number of conversions. This only includes conversion actions which include_in_conversions_metric attribute is set to true.

columns.name: metrics_all_conversions_value
columns.comment: The total value of all conversions.

columns.name: metrics_conversions
columns.comment: The number of conversions. This only includes conversion actions which include_in_conversions_metric attribute is set to true.

columns.name: metrics_conversions_value
columns.comment: The total value of conversions. This only includes conversion actions which include_in_conversions_metric attribute is set to true.

columns.name: metrics_cross_device_conversions
columns.comment: Conversions from when a customer clicks on a Google Ads ad on one device, then converts on a different device or browser. Cross-device conversions are already included in all_conversions.

columns.name: metrics_value_per_all_conversions
columns.comment: The value of all conversions divided by the number of all conversions.

columns.name: metrics_value_per_conversion
columns.comment: The value of conversions divided by the number of conversions. This only includes conversion actions which include_in_conversions_metric attribute is set to true.

columns.name: metrics_view_through_conversions
columns.comment: The total number of view-through conversions. These happen when a customer sees an image or rich media ad, then later completes a conversion on your site without interacting with (e.g., clicking on) another ad.

columns.name: segments_ad_network_type
columns.comment: Ad network type.

columns.name: segments_conversion_action
columns.comment: Resource name of the conversion action.

columns.name: segments_conversion_action_category
columns.comment: Conversion action category.

columns.name: segments_conversion_action_name
columns.comment: Conversion action name.

columns.name: segments_date
columns.comment: Date to which metrics apply. yyyy-MM-dd format, e.g., 2018-04-17.

columns.name: segments_day_of_week
columns.comment: Day of the week, e.g., MONDAY.

columns.name: segments_device
columns.comment: Device to which metrics apply.

columns.name: segments_geo_target_most_specific_location
columns.comment: Resource name of the geo target constant that represents the most specific location.

columns.name: segments_month
columns.comment: Month as represented by the date of the first day of a month. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

columns.name: segments_quarter
columns.comment: Quarter as represented by the date of the first day of a quarter. Uses the calendar year for quarters, e.g., the second quarter of 2018 starts on 2018-04-01. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

columns.name: segments_week
columns.comment: Week as defined as Monday through Sunday, and represented by the date of Monday. Formatted as yyyy-MM-dd.

columns.name: segments_year
columns.comment: Year, formatted as yyyy.
